q: 1. Another aim of e-procurement is increased choice of supplier leading to sourcing items:
explain: answer in book is C As per scribid E-procurement widens the pool of accessible suppliers online, so buyers can source items from the right source among a broader supplier base.

q: 2. The chart which gives an estimate about the amount of materials handling between various workstation is known as
explain: A travel chart tabulates the quantity of material moved between workstations, so it is used to analyse material handling.

q: 3. During storage of cement, the bag of cement should be kept......cm apart from the walls.
explain: Standard site storage specifications mandate keeping cement stacks at least 30 cm (12 inches) away from exterior walls to prevent moisture absorption from walls.

q: 4. Which of the following is not an excavating equipment?
explain: Per the answer key, scraper is the odd one out (it is mainly a hauling/spreading machine); shovel, dragline and hoe are excavators.

q: 5. For excavating solid rocks, the most suitable equipment is
explain: The answer key gives hoe (d). Note: many textbooks name the power shovel for blasted rock.

q: 6. The size of a power shovel is indicated by the size of
explain: A power shovel is rated by its dipper (bucket) capacity in cubic metres or cubic yards.

q: 7. Which one of the following does not form a part of Derrick crane?
explain: A derrick crane consists of a mast, boom and guy ropes; a jack is not part of it.

q: 8. Which one of the following does not fall under the category hoisting equipment?
explain: A dragline is an excavator, not hoisting equipment. Per the key, d is correct.

q: 9. Tractive coefficient of a Crawler truck in loose soil is
options: less than that of rubber tyre tractors
more than it at of rubber tyre tractors
same as that of rubber tyre tractors
explain: Tracks grip loose soil better than rubber tyres, so the tractive coefficient is higher.

q: 10. The chart which gives an estimate about the amount of materials handling between various work stations is known as
explain: A travel chart (from-to chart) quantifies material movement/handling volume between different work stations.

q: 11. The handling of materials in the construction of a multistoreyed building will require for lifting
explain: Vertical lifting of materials in multistoreyed buildings is done by hoists.

q: 12. The construction equipment suitable for lifting and transportation is
explain: Per the answer key, lift truck and spiral chute (a and c) are suitable.

q: 13. Vibratory rollers are more useful for compacting which of the following
explain: Vibration rearranges granular particles into a dense state, so it suits sandy (cohesionless) soils best.

q: 14. Bottom-dump wagons are suitable for handling which of the following
explain: Free-flowing materials such as sand and gravel discharge easily from bottom-dump wagons. Sticky clay and large rocks do not.

q: 15. Which one of the following rollers is suitable for soil cement stabilized road construction?
explain: Per the answer key, vibratory roller (a) is correct.

q: 16. The most suitable type of equipment for compaction of cohesive soils is
explain: Sheep foot rollers knead and compact clayey (cohesive) soils.

q: 17. A crusher which can be used as either primary or secondary crusher is
explain: Per the answer key, hammer mill (a). Note: some books give jaw crusher.

q: 18. A concrete mixer is specified by
options: the volume of the mixing drum
volume of mixed concrete discharges after mixing of each batch
explain: Mixers are rated by their output, the volume of mixed concrete discharged per batch.

q: 19. The horse power of driving motor of a 5 cubic metre concrete mixer would be about
explain: Per the answer key, about 5 HP.

q: 20. Material used for the construction of load bearing piles is
explain: Load-bearing piles can be made of timber, concrete or steel.

q: 21. Which of the following equipments is not used for hauling
explain: Per the answer key, d (scrapers). Note: a dragline is an excavator, so many books give c.

q: 22. Which of the following conveyor is never used?
explain: All three types are used in practice, so none is 'never used'.

q: 23. A canal is trimmed on its side and bottom by
explain: A trimmer is the machine used to trim canal sides and bottom to the final shape.

q: 24. The process of removal and loading of broken rock pieces from a tunnel is known as
explain: Mucking is the removal and loading of blasted rock (muck) in tunnelling.

q: 25. A golden rule for the procurement of construction stores, suggests
options: 67% at the site and 33% under procurement
50% at the site and 50% under procurement
33% at the site and 67% under procurement
explain: The conventional guideline for stores management suggests keeping about two-thirds (67%) of material at site and one-third (33%) in the procurement pipeline.

q: 26. The most suitable type of equipment for compaction of cohesive soils is
explain: Sheep foot rollers knead and compact clayey (cohesive) soils.

q: 27. For a given size of bucket, the ideal output of a dragline will be least in
explain: Wet sticky clay is hard to dig and sticks in the bucket, so the output is lowest.

q: 28. Which one of the following surface will give highest coefficient of traction while using crawler track tractors?
explain: Per the answer key, earth, where the track grousers can grip.

q: 29. Which of the following surfaces will give highest rolling resistance for a rubber tyred vehicle?
explain: Tyres sink into loose sand, giving the highest rolling resistance.

q: 30. A concrete mixer is specified by
options: the volume of the mixing drum
Volume of mixed concrete discharged after mixing of each batch
explain: A concrete mixer's specification includes drum volume, drum speed, and output volume per batch - all these parameters together specify it.

q: 31. A golden rule for the procurement of construction stores is that
options: half of the construction stores should be at work site and half under procurement
two-third of the construction stores should be at work site and one-third under procurement
three-fourth of the construction stores should be at work site and one-fourth under procurement
whole of the construction store should be at work site
explain: Per the answer key, two-thirds at site and one-third under procurement.

q: 32. Weight-batching proceeds on
options: the assumption of the declared weight in each bag of cement
weighing the contents of each bag
accurately estimating the weight of each material to be used in each batch
the assumption of correct dry weight of each size range of each material and the weight of water
explain: Per the answer key, c: the weight of each material for a batch is estimated and weighed accurately.

q: 33. The chart which gives an estimate about the amount of materials handling between various work stations is known as :
explain: A travel chart is used to analyze the movement of materials and personnel between different locations.

q: 34. In Nepal, Public Procurement Act (PPA), was effective from
explain: Nepal's Public Procurement Act (PPA) came into effect in 2063 BS.

q: 35. The pump suitable for high discharge pressure
explain: Reciprocating pumps develop high discharge pressure.

q: 36. For procurement of works upto Rs. 2 million, by which of the following method of procurement is considered?
options: by direct labour or direct negotiation
explain: Public procurement guidelines specify that works valued up to Rs. 2 million can be procured through the sealed quotation method.

q: 37. Screw pumps are used for pumping
explain: Screw pumps handle highly viscous liquids.

q: 38. The resources in a construction project are made up of
options: plant equipment and machinery required for the project
construction material such as cement, bricks, steel etc
explain: Resources are machinery, materials and manpower.

q: 39. Which of the following earth moving machines has the shortest cycle time?
explain: A dipper (power) shovel has the shortest cycle time.

q: 40. For which of the following materials, the output of power shovels for a fixed shovel size will be maximum
explain: Per the answer key, moist loam, which digs easily and fills the dipper well.

q: 41. Which of the following excavators is most suitable for digging under water?
explain: Per the answer key, dragline. Note: many books give clamshell.

q: 42. Which of the following method of procurement is not applicable for material management?
explain: Cost and quality based selection (QCBS) is used for consultancy service selection, not for procurement of materials/goods.

q: 43. Clamshell are used to remove loose material from inside
explain: Clamshells dig deep, narrow holes such as cofferdams, pier foundations and manholes.

q: 44. Which of the following is not another name of Hoe?
explain: A trenching machine is a different machine. Backhoe, back-shovel and pull shovel are names for the hoe.

q: 45. Hoe is primarily used to excavate
options: below the natural surface of the ground on which the machine rests
trenches requiring precise control of depth
pits of basements requiring precise control of depth
explain: A hoe digs below its own level, including trenches and basement pits.

q: 46. Idlers are
options: used to provide supports for belt conveyor system
explain: Idlers are the rollers that support a conveyor belt.

q: 47. Which of the following is a primary process for procurement of goods and services from a competitive market?
explain: Bidding is the primary competitive process used to procure goods and services from the open market.

q: 48. Travel chart are used to
options: plan material handling procedure and routes
explain: Per the answer key, all of the above.

q: 49. Size of a dragline is indicated by the size of
explain: A dragline is rated by its bucket capacity.

q: 50. The object of technical drawing is
explain: Technical drawings provide dimensions and details necessary for estimate preparation, material take-offs, and resource procurement.
